lines.text: Could you miss a gorilla walking right past you?
People counted basketball passes in a short video.
Midway, someone in a gorilla suit strolled through the game.
More than half never saw the gorilla.
Focus is a spotlight, not a floodlight.
So what are you missing right now?

post.title: Why You Can Miss a Gorilla Right in Front of You #shorts
post.description: Could you miss a gorilla walking right past you? In Simons & Chabris (1999), more than half of people counting basketball passes never saw a person in a gorilla suit stroll through the game. That's inattentional blindness.
